.github/workflows/native-runtime-release.name: Publish selected existing tag only, without moving tags or overwriting releases
Revalidate live exact-head CI, both native VM receipts and offline publisher identity
.github/workflows/native-runtime-release.run:
cd "$NATIVE_WORKSPACE"
python3 tools/native_release_gate.py --version "$NATIVE_VERSION" --commit "$REVIEWED_COMMIT" \
  --ci-run "$REVIEWED_CI_RUN" --predecessor-run "$PREDECESSOR_RUN" --publish \
  --receipts "$PWD/target/native-vm" --release-directory "$PWD/target/native-release" \
  --output "$PWD/target/native-release-acceptance.json"
gh attestation trusted-root > "$NATIVE_TRUST/trusted_root.jsonl"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from tools.native_runtime import verify
decision = json.loads(Path("target/native-release-acceptance.json").read_text())
trust = Path(os.environ["NATIVE_TRUST"])
policy = trust / "publisher-policy.json"
policy.write_text(json.dumps(decision["publisherPolicy"]))
with verify.release(Path("target/native-release").resolve(), decision["version"],
                    verify.PublisherTrust(policy, trust / "trusted_root.jsonl", Path(shutil.which("gh")).resolve())):
    pass
PY
